title: Feeding Birds in the Park
paragraphs: Every Friday afternoon, Latif visits the small park near the mosque with a bag of seeds to feed the sparrows that gather there, a quiet routine he has kept for almost a year now.
A young boy watching him one day asks why he bothers feeding birds that could easily find their own food elsewhere in the city without anyone's help at all.

Latif explains that he simply enjoys the stillness of the moment, watching the birds gather calmly around him, and that caring for small creatures, even in a small way, brings him a quiet sense of peace.

The boy asks to try feeding them too, and Latif shows him gently how to hold his hand still. Watching the boy's delighted face, Latif realizes his simple habit had quietly grown into something worth sharing.
